auditFindings2026-11-07: The provenance contract (data/SOURCES.md + PROVENANCE.sha256) covers the package, boundaries and elevation stats rigorously, but NONE of the remote map layers in docs/app.js were covered by any manifest. This file closes that gap.

Two different DEMs are user-visible simultaneously: terrain display uses the terrarium (SRTM-blend) tiles, district elevation stats use GLO-30. Any future on-screen elevation readout must state which DEM it sampled.
Esri World Imagery is an undated mosaic — the only explorer layer with no date policy at all. Wayback releases are the dated form of the same pyramid.
GIBS VIIRS is already genuinely live (runtime-dated daily). The freshness gap is high-resolution imagery, not satellite data in general.

Phase 1 (2026-11-07): the terrain source was swapped from the AWS Mapzen terrarium blend (SRTM 2000 flight) to FABDEM v1.2 bare-earth, license-audited as CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and accepted by the maintainer. Terrain (bare-earth) and the district elevation choropleth (GLO-30 surface model) remain different DEMs — the panel says so.
